ctx.x: Oh yeah. He's still doing a thing today.

Johnny Otis was playing the Club Alabam, and there was a band down there called Harlan Leonard and his Kansas City Rockets. They were there in California. So I happened to have been down there one day, and just foolin'

around. So here's a guy comes in from Twin Falls, Idaho. Here's a little story for you. And he walked up to me, and he said, "I'm lookin' for a four piece band to go to play about five months in Twin Falls, Idaho. I can pay $600, room and board." I said, "Come this way, sir." And this guy -- this really happened. So I had my group I was rehearsing, because I was getting restless. I accepted that job. You know, we went to Twin Falls, Idaho, and it was a beautiful thing, and this is how I started my group, my small…
